استغفرا (form X)

# اُسْتُغْفِرَا (ustuḡfirā) /us.tuɣ.fi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
# اِسْتَغْفِرَا (istaḡfirā) /is.taɣ.fi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
